svg.metadata: {"source_asset": {"id": "core.organelle.lipid_droplet", "name": "Lipid Droplet", "category": "organelle", "tags": ["lipid droplet", "organelle", "metabolism", "lipid", "schematic"], "description": "Original vector lipid droplet with a neutral-lipid core, phospholipid monolayer cue, restrained highlight, and editable semantic regions.", "file": "svg/lipid_droplet.svg", "source_type": "original_vector_draft", "license": "CC0-1.0", "provenance": "Original vector draft created for Figure Studio from a generic organelle concept; no proprietary reference image, scraping, tracing, or protected asset-library recreation was used.", "style_family": "figure-studio-soft-line-v1", "review_status": "visual_reviewed_2026_07_18", "style_status": "soft_line_v1_organelle_refresh", "mvp_quality": "curated", "editable_region_count": 3, "reviewer_notes": "Rebuilt with an organic neutral-lipid silhouette, restrained specular accents, and sparse monolayer ticks so it reads as a lipid droplet rather than a generic filled circle.", "editable_color_regions": [{"id": "droplet", "label": "Droplet fill", "default": "#F4A261", "paint": "fill"}, {"id": "highlight", "label": "Droplet highlight/accent", "default": "#FFE3B3", "paint": "stroke"}, {"id": "outline", "label": "Droplet outline", "default": "#26323D", "paint": "stroke"}]}, "source_archive": "scientific-packs(1).zip", "source_svg": "scientific-packs/core-biology/svg/lipid_droplet.svg", "output_style": "Style 4", "batch": "008", "source_record_is_unmodified": true, "output_review_status": "XML, source-structure checks and rendered visual review; not a new scientific validation"}
